owner_and_capability: Sixth slice of #4076, projection reads behind consumer ports (ADR 0058): Care Plan's request feed and student directory reads and Timetable's enrollment provenance lookup run through ports their own packages declare; new projection compose packages build the readers and the root binds them.

atomic_cutover: Code cutover without a new rule or policy epoch. Care Plan declares requestfeed.FeedSource and postgres.StudentDirectory, Timetable declares postgres.EnrollmentProvenance; modules/parentrequestfeedprojection/compose, modules/studentdirectoryview/compose and modules/timetableenrollmentprovenance/compose only construct their readers; api binds them (api/parent_request_feed.go and the Care Plan and Timetable constructions). Every projection read keeps running in the caller's transaction and the provenance lookup keeps its FOR UPDATE. The Data Import school lookups, Care Plan's student-name adapter and Timetable's advisory locks move to the root, so the compose total falls 89899 -> 89865. Test support gets testpkg.StudentDirectory and testpkg.EnrollmentProvenance; careplantest.NewCarePlan takes the reader from its callers. The stale rule data-import.compose.school-name.organization-tenancy is deleted.
